data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name Harelei, Harrell refers to a meadow where hares are abundant. This name may symbolize fertility, abundance, or the grace and agility of hares. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
